input_schema.name: input
input_schema.note: first_blood_radiant is encoded as float (True=1.0, False=0.0, missing=0.5) before this point, matching train.py/train_live.py's _prepare_xy. Missing/absent features must be filled with 0.0 before scaling, matching training-time behavior (df.fillna(0.0)).

output_schema.name: probabilities
output_schema.note: column 1 (index 1) is P(radiant_win=1). zipmap disabled so output is a plain float tensor, not a list of dicts.

calibration_replication.reconstruction_note: predicted = clip(x, min(x_thresholds), max(x_thresholds)); then linear-interpolate y_thresholds over x_thresholds at that clipped x (numpy: np.interp(x_clipped, x_thresholds, y_thresholds)). Equivalent to sklearn.isotonic.IsotonicRegression.predict with out_of_bounds='clip'.

calibration_recheck_on_exported_model.note: Matches (within float32 tolerance) the training-time calibration/AUC recorded in evaluation.json, confirming the exported graph did not shift the output distribution.

validation.test_inputs_description: 6 fixed rows: all-zero, large-positive, large-negative, mid-boundary, 2 representative random rows
validation.latency_note: averaged over 200 calls, single row, CPUExecutionProvider, this dev machine -- rough sanity figure only, not a rigorous benchmark
